footnotes_as_printed: none printed on the table; text: values are averages of duplicate samples, last digit not significant above 1.0 mol/kg, blank spaces for Li2SO4 and K2SO4 mean solubility limit exceeded
pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium, no pressure measured or reported)

value.what: isopiestic molality of the Na2SO4(aq) test solution in equilibrium (common vapour phase, separate cup) with the NaCl(aq) reference solution of the same printed row

value2.what: isopiestic molality of the NaCl(aq) reference solution of the same printed row

composition.other_species: each column is a separate solution in isopiestic equilibrium through the common vapour phase, not a mixture. Test salt Na2SO4 (value); reference NaCl(aq) (value2). Li2SO4, K2SO4, Cs2SO4 columns are outside the six-ion set and are not mapped

conversion_needs: isopiestic molality of Na2SO4 relates to osmotic coefficient via phi_x = phi_NaCl * m_NaCl / (nu * m_x) style isopiestic ratio; needs reference phi of NaCl (not converted here)
blank cells = not measured (solubility limit exceeded)
notes: Printed as two side-by-side blocks of 5 columns (NaCl, Li2SO4, Na2SO4, K2SO4, Cs2SO4) per row. Stacked here: within each temperature, all left-block rows in printed order, then all right-block rows. Each row is one isopiestic equilibrium (NaCl and the sulfates in the same row are mutually in equilibrium). The printed left/right halves are not guaranteed to be duplicate pairs (e.g. 383.14 K row 3 right half is a different molality level than its left half). Blank cells are empty strings. Misprint-looking printed values kept as printed: see paper.json quality_remarks.

row_held.reason: Na2SO4 cell blank in the printed table (383.14 K, 7th row of each half); no test-salt value to attach
